summary:
The Corinth Tour from Athens is a full-day excursion west of the Greek capital, focusing on a region closely connected with both ancient Greek and Roman history. After leaving Athens, travel to Corinth for guided sightseeing and time to understand the city’s historical importance. You return to Athens later the same day, so the tour fits easily into a city stay without requiring an additional hotel night.
An English-speaking professional guide accompanies the excursion, with entrance fees for the scheduled visits included. All road travel is arranged by air-conditioned coach, covering the journey from Athens to Corinth and back.

highlights: Discover the rich history of Ancient Corinth on this guided tour from Athens. Visit important archaeological landmarks including the Temple of Apollo at Corinth, the Ancient Agora, and other ruins of the ancient city once visited by St. Paul. Enjoy a stop at the impressive Corinth Canal, connecting the Aegean and Ionian Seas. After the tour, return to Athens.

itinerary.title: From Athens: Half-Day Ancient Corinth Tour
itinerary.text:
08:00am Depart from Athens and drive to the famous Corinth Canal for a short photo stop. Continue to Ancient Corinth, where St. Paul lived and preached for nearly two years during his missionary journeys.
Explore the impressive Ancient Agora, the Temple of Apollo, and the fascinating archaeological site, offering a glimpse into one of Greece's most important ancient cities. Before returning to Athens, stop at the ancient port of Cenchreae (Kechries), where St. Paul is believed to have departed for Ephesus.
Arrive back in Athens around lunchtime and transfer to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure.

faqs.q: What is included in the Corinth Tour from Athens?
faqs.a: The Corinth Tour from Athens is a half-day excursion to one of Greece's most important archaeological sites. The tour includes transportation from Athens, a visit to the famous Corinth Canal, the ancient city of Corinth, the Temple of Apollo, and other important historical landmarks associated with ancient Greek and Roman history.

faqs.q: How much does the Corinth Tour from Athens cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €95 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes round-trip transportation, professional English-speaking guide services, and sightseeing according to the itinerary. Entrance fees may vary depending on the package selected.

faqs.q: How long does the Corinth Tour last?
faqs.a: The tour lasts approximately 5 hours, including travel time from Athens. It is an ideal half-day excursion for travelers who want to explore an important historical site while still having free time in Athens later in the day.

faqs.q: What are the main attractions visited during the tour?
faqs.a: Highlights include the impressive Corinth Canal, Ancient Corinth, the Temple of Apollo, the Agora, Roman ruins, and panoramic views of the surrounding region. Visitors also learn about the city's significance during ancient Greek, Roman, and early Christian periods.

faqs.q: Does the Corinth Tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the tour. Your guide will explain the history, archaeology, mythology, and cultural importance of Corinth throughout the excursion.

Ancient Corinth was one of the wealthiest and most influential cities in ancient Greece due to its strategic location between mainland Greece and the Peloponnese. It was also an important center during the Roman period and is closely associated with the travels of Saint Paul.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Visitors should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites and uneven surfaces. Most travelers with average fitness levels can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What should I wear for the Corinth Tour?
faqs.a: Comfortable walking shoes are recommended. During warmer months, visitors should bring sunscreen, sunglasses, a hat, and water. Casual, weather-appropriate clothing is ideal for exploring the archaeological site.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Corinth Tour from Athens?
faqs.a: You can generally cancel free of charge up to 24 to 48 hours before the tour departure time, depending on the operator's policy. Cancellations made closer to departure may be subject to fees.

faqs.q: Is the Corinth Tour from Athens suitable for first-time visitors to Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is an excellent option for first-time visitors interested in ancient history, archaeology, and biblical heritage. Its close proximity to Athens makes it one of the most popular day trips from the Greek capital.
